CustomField.description: Sum of all ARR under the Ultimate Parent Account (https://app.asana.com/0/1169811029711865/1200235963009047/f).
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(UltimateParentAccount__c), IF( ISBLANK(Total_Account_ARR__c), TotalChildrenARR__c, IF( ISBLANK(TotalChildrenARR__c), Total_Account_ARR__c, BLANKVALUE(TotalChildrenARR__c, 0) + BLANKVALUE(Total_Account_ARR__c, 0) ) ), IF( ISBLANK(UltimateParentAccount__r.Total_Account_ARR__c), UltimateParentAccount__r.TotalChildrenARR__c, BLANKVALUE(UltimateParentAccount__r.TotalChildrenARR__c, 0) + BLANKVALUE(UltimateParentAccount__r.Total_Account_ARR__c, 0) ) )
CustomField.label: Total Hierarchy ARR
